description: A real cross-language divergence a code review found (2026-09-21): id_from's named scope var bound to JSON null (an optional tool arg the model's own JSON round-trips as explicit null, the same shape null-interpolation.json documents as real) must mean 'no id' the same as a genuinely absent key - TS's own first draft checked only `=== undefined` and would have called host.artifact.update() with a literal null artifact_id for this exact input. Proves both interpreters agree it's a create.
